summary.t: Sitting, with a curled tail and painted stripes.

text.t: The cat is sitting, with its tail curled in front of its paws and hand-painted stripes. Its eyes are closed and its ears are upright.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are not included. The cable version comes with a remote control: on, off, dimming, auto-off, and a slow pulsing light effect.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date, or a short phrase, engraved on the wood. Leave blank if you prefer no engraving.
